compiled_state.title: test-merge-to-main-pr.sh: 4 draft-guard tests fail (_head_sha unbound in PR_LIB_MODE wrapper)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Bug Report

4 behavioral tests in tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh fail due to `set -u` + `_head_sha: unbound variable` in the `_run_check_duplicate_pr` wrapper.

## Failing tests
- t_draft_pr_from_active_sprint_allowed
- t_stale_draft_pr_allowed  
- t_check_duplicate_pr_malformed_json_passes_through
- t_check_duplicate_pr_isdraft_filter_returns_empty_not_null

## Root cause
The _run_check_duplicate_pr wrapper sources merge-to-main-pr.sh with PR_LIB_MODE=1 and uses set +e but not set +u. When bash processes function definitions under nounset mode, _head_sha (a local variable declared but not yet assigned) triggers 'unbound variable' error, causing the wrapper to abort with exit 1.

## Fix
Add `set +u` to the _run_check_duplicate_pr wrapper heredoc (after `set +e`), OR initialize _head_sha before use in merge-to-main-pr.sh.

## Impact
Story 3d09-1ba7-fbd1-40fa completion blocked — these tests must pass for DD2 (non-draft guard behavior) and DD4 (unit tests passing).
